items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: It's just unique or different from the singers, guys like Dean Martin, he's not a great singer, but you become very popular.

ctx.x: Sure. Nat tried to tell me that when he said, I can't either, but he said I could and I did, and he said they wouldn't expect as much out of me; he said you would just learn whatever you could do.

Sometimes your very lack of ability is the thing that people like. It's just unique or different from the singers, guys like Dean Martin, he's not a great singer, but you become very popular. It's like a hit record, who cares how good a record is, as long as it sells.
However, In The Mood, was very well done.
